Wine Steam window compatibility — LGPL-2.1-or-later

Cross-process child window layer hosting: James, Wine bug 60263 attachment 82030,
as attributed in typester/sake patch 0005. D3DMetal hosted swapchain adaptation:
typester/sake patch 0006. Scotch ports these changes to WineForge 0.6.0.3 / Wine
11.16 and scopes the matched DXMT loader policy to Steam's CEF executable.

The upstream patches explicitly disclose AI assistance. Existing Wine/CodeWeavers
copyright and license notices remain in the complete sources. See Wine-LGPL-2.1.txt
for license terms and Scotch/scripts/graphics/wine-steam-surfaces.patch in the
DMG's corresponding-source archive for the exact modifications and origins.

https://github.com/typester/sake/tree/main/patches
https://bugs.winehq.org/show_bug.cgi?id=60263
